lic_summary: Some mods are available only to their author's members. Sign in to the author's site once; the license is renewed automatically before it expires.
lic_intro: Some mods are available only to their author's members. Sign in to the author's site once; this program renews the license before it expires.
lic_other_account: The license on this computer is for another game account
lic_invalid: The license on this computer is not signed by this author's key
lic_key_changed: A mod declares a different key for this author. Check where it came from.
lic_no_account: There is no game account on this computer yet. Start the game once.
lic_test_issuer: Test build: this issuer exists only for testing, so there is nowhere to sign in. Use the author's released version.
lic_bad_declaration: This mod's license declaration (hd2_license.json) cannot be read.
lic_nothing: No mod in the library requires a license, and no author is signed in on this computer.
lic_no_mods: No mod in the library currently requires this license
lic_ask: Your browser will open {0}, the site of {1}. That site receives your game account ID ({2}).
lic_waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser…
lic_page_close: You can close this page and return to the manager.
lic_sign_out_ask: Remove this author's license and sign-in from this computer? Their mods will not work until you sign in again.
lic_err_not_member: This account is not an active member, or its tier is too low.
lic_err_account_limit: This membership already has as many game accounts as the creator allows. Another can replace one some time after the last was added (the sign-in page says when); if you cannot wait, contact the creator.
lic_err_account_limit_wait: This membership already has as many game accounts as the creator allows. Another can replace one in {0} days; if you cannot wait, contact the creator.
lic_err_denied: Access was not granted on the author's site.
lic_err_timeout: The sign-in did not finish within 10 minutes.
lic_err_network: The author's site cannot be reached.
lic_err_bad_license: The license received is not signed by the key the mod declares.
lic_err_key_changed: A mod declares a different key for this author. Check where it came from.
lic_err_sign_in_again: The author's site asks you to sign in again.
row_license_test_tip: This mod is a test build: its license names a test issuer, where nobody can sign in. Use the author's released version.
row_license_tip: For the author's members: sign in on the Plugins page (the jigsaw piece beside the gear).
